messages:
anya: Quick share — ran a cross-zone zipbench comparing A100 vs H100 for redwood-7b and redwood-13b. Focus: prefill P50/P95, decode P50/P95, steady tokens/sec, and $/1M tokens. Uploaded raw csv and traces: https://drive.redwood/zipbench.csv :chart_with_upwards_trend:
infra-bot: perf-run job started: job_id=z-2219-01 nodes: a100=3 h100=3 models=[redwood-7b,redwood-13b] quants=[q4_0,q5_0] seq=2048 qps_sweep 5-200
michael: nice, can you drop the top-line numbers here?
anya: paste summary below (all p95s in ms, tokens/sec = steady-state decode throughput, $/1M tok = estimated infra cost at our spot rates)
anya: Model | GPU | Prefill P95 | Decode P95 | tokens/sec | $/1M tok
anya: redwood-7b | A100 | 24 | 42 | 18k | $14
anya: redwood-7b | H100 | 18 | 30 | 27k | $12
anya: redwood-13b | A100 | 45 | 78 | 8k  | $30
anya: redwood-13b | H100 | 34 | 60 | 12k | $24
anya: Notes: q4_0 on H100 = ~7-12% faster decode vs q5_0 (kernel alignment + better fp16 paths). On A100, q5_0 sometimes regressed ~4% on decode for 13B due to less optimal matmuls.
devon: region diffs?
anya: eu-west tail was ~8% worse p95 across the board (NVLink cross-zone noise + occasional PG eviction). us-west1 and us-central comparable. For cross-zone bursts prefer H100 pools or local-prefill caching.
sara: any regressions on quality with q4_0?
anya: small LM-llama evals show <0.5% metric drift on rouge/emulate for 7B; 13B q4_0 had occasional tokenization edgecases (~1% top-k change) — capturing eval diffs in the uploads. Not major but flagging for ops.
ops: cost note — H100 spot is pricier per-hour in eu-west, but throughput gains reduce $/1M tokens at >40% utilization. A100 still wins at low util (<20%).
michael: can you paste the run command so infra can repro?
anya: ```
bench-run \
  --model redwood-7b,redwood-13b \
  --gpus a100:3,h100:3 \
  --quant q4_0,q5_0 \
  --seq 2048 \
  --qps-schedule linear:5:200 \
  --duration 30m \
  --regions us-west1,eu-west1,us-central \
  --trace perf,kvcache,allocs \
  --output s3://redwood-benches/zipbench-2219876543.csv
```
michael: perfect, thanks. can you also include per-request kv-cache hit rate?
anya: yes — average prefix cache hit was 62% on steady-state 7B tests; 13B was 48% because longer contexts evicted more often. I'll attach the kv charts.
devon: curious about kernel fallback behavior — did any runs hit non-opt kernels?
anya: on A100 we saw occasional kernel fallthrough for q4_0 when sequence>1500; on H100 fallthroughs were negligible. Logged kernel types per step in the trace csv.
anya: TL;DR for app teams: H100 gives clear P95 and tokens/sec wins for 13B and high-QPS 7B traffic; for small-scale usage A100 + conservative quant (q5_0) still cheaper. Filing a follow-up doc with region-specific sizing recs and rollout plan. :memo:
ops: will review cost calc and region SKU availability, ping if you want a reserved vs on-demand delta.
anya: thanks — attaching traces and the brief in #eng-ml-docs later today. :white_check_mark:
